channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Manhattan-sized ice island breaks off Greenland's Petermann Glacier
item.description: A Manhattan-sized ice island broke from Petermann Glacier after years of fractures weakened its floating ice tongue.

item.title: One asteroid strike may explain two mysteries of Mars' moon Deimos
item.description: A single asteroid impact may explain Deimos' large southern depression and its smooth, dusty surface, simulations suggest.

item.title: DNA from 190-year-old specimen reveals new pangolin species
item.description: DNA extracted from a nearly 190-year-old museum specimen has confirmed a distinct Himalayan pangolin species in Nepal and nearby regions.

item.title: NSF invests $90M in three new Science and Technology Centers
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation is investing $90 million over five years to establish three new Science and Technology Centers for transformative research.
